target: acceptances 1+3 — a missing or empty signal list refuses outright, never 'reversible for everything'. This is the only fail-closed path.
cmd: mkdir -p empty; : > empty/irreversible-signals.txt; e=$(IRREVERSIBLE_SIGNALS="$PWD/empty/irreversible-signals.txt" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible "$FIXTURES/irreversible/plain.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; e2=$(IRREVERSIBLE_SIGNALS="$PWD/nope.txt" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible "$FIXTURES/irreversible/plain.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c2=$?; n=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$e" "$e2" | grep -ci "signal list"); printf '{"c":%s,"c2":%s,"namesList":%s}' "$c" "$c2" "$n"
